newsitem.title: USA: King World says top 25 markets on board.
newsitem.headline: King World says top 25 markets on board.

text.p: King World Productions Inc said in a statement Tuesday that television stations in all of the United States' top 25 markets are now committed to carry the syndication's top two programs, "Wheel of Fortune" and "Jeopardy!"
The company also said that more than 70 stations representing over 70 percent of the country will carry the shows for the next five seasons.
King World also distributes "The Oprah Winfrey Show and "Inside Edition."
